title: Review the Maintainer settings of docs/merge-guard.md and accept ADR 0007
notes: Who may push to main, a real CODEOWNERS (today '* @owner', an unrelated account), Pipelines must succeed, threads, approvals, push rules. Then set the ADR to accepted. Full hands-off also needs AFAW_AUTO_MERGE and a token, or GitLab's merge when pipeline succeeds.
